rationale: X serves the maintainer at least as well as the references. It accurately traces path resolution, `ActiveSupport::ConfigurationFile` parsing, ERB evaluation, Psych loading and error wrapping, whole-document deep symbolization, `env.to_sym` selection, the typed `shared` merge branches, and the final root-only `ActiveSupport::OrderedOptions` wrapping. It covers every requested edge case, including arrays, source-implied scalar environment values, absent environments, empty and missing files, and the stale `YAML.load` stub behind the `symbolize_names` compatibility test. Its contract-versus-mechanics distinctions agree with the implementation and tests. The focused existing checks also passed: 18 `config_for` tests with 30 assertions and 4 configuration-file parser tests with 10 assertions, with no failures or errors.
